guard: An effect's option bag is read as the table says: every accepted key is forwarded to the handler, the hashed ones decide divergence on a resume, and a subject the table cannot read is refused rather than coerced; and a `placement` that is not an { endpoint, instanceId } pair of non-empty strings is refused by name before the identity projection reads into it
proveWith: pnpm mutation-proof --config packages/lang/smoke/mutations/spawn-subject.json   # --config resolves against the repo root, never the cwd
why: Batch B2 (2026-09-03), from a full-code audit: the record form of `spawn` read its persona
through `String(...)`, so `spawn({ model: "m" })` resolved to the literal persona
"undefined" and carried it into the input hash, the step name and the handler's request.
A missing persona is `undefined` crossing an effect boundary, which is what L3041 names.
#1628 (2026-09-15): `option()` guards the option BAG being null, not the VALUE it holds, so
`placement: null` was forwarded, cast, and dereferenced by the step-identity projection as a raw
TypeError - with no code, no effect kind and no journal entry, at the exact place the runtime's
own named refusal was written to speak. A primitive, an empty record and a half-filled record
were quieter and worse: forwarded too, projecting two undefined fields into the identity.

mutations.note: Measured 2026-09-03: KILLED. Thrown red: `Error: FAIL: a spawn record with no persona is refused as L3041, never spawned as the persona "undefined" - {"code":"L4000","kind":"handler-fault"}` — without the refusal the persona "undefined" reaches the handler and faults there instead, which is the whole point. Its completion is named on an EARLY printed line rather than the suite summary: options.smoke's `ok` THROWS on the first failure, so a killed mutant never reaches `options.smoke:` and a summary marker would grade every kill here as inconclusive.

This is the mutant that a null-only fix would survive and a shape fix does not: `null`, a primitive and an array are all admitted as placements again, so the null crashes in the projection and the other two project two undefined fields into the step identity.
